about_the_game:
• Solo-developed with love and obsession.

About the Game

  • A young girl, longing to escape the real world, finds herself lost within the depths of her own mind. This is her story—a quiet journey through an inner landscape shaped by emotion, memory, and mystery.

    This is a demo version of the game. For full details, please refer to the main product page.

  • Storage: 5 GB available space
